### 3.2 Ruff lint — PARTIAL

Configuration: `pyproject.toml` lines 45–56, `select = ["E","F","I","W","UP","B","C4","PTH","SIM"]`, `ignore = ["E501"]`, per-file ignores for `tests/*`, `scripts/*`, `blender_live_bridge.py`.

- **Before fix:** 192 errors across 14 rule codes.
- **After `--fix` (safe only):** 155 fixed, **35 remaining** in legacy modules:
  - `package/addon/simple_mcp_addon.py` — E402 (imports not at top), PTH118/119/103 (os.path → Path), SIM105, E722 (bare except)
  - `safety_simulation/blender_bridge.py` — F401 (`bpy` unused)
  - `safety_simulation/{fume_hood,ghs,neutralization_drill,thermal_runaway}.py` — UP042 (`str & Enum` inheritance), SIM102 (nested if), B007 (unused loop var)
- These are pre-existing style issues in legacy modules; per the project directive ("no blind overwrites of existing working modules") they are **documented, not refactored** in this session.
- 14 unsafe fixes available via `--fix --unsafe-fixes` were deliberately not applied.

### 3.3 mypy type-check — PARTIAL

Configuration: `pyproject.toml` lines 58–63, `python_version = "3.12"`, strict mode (`warn_return_any`, `disallow_untyped_defs`, `strict`).

- Scoped to production package `src/chemlab` with `--ignore-missing-imports --follow-imports=skip --no-site-packages` (to skip the broken third-party `rdkit-stubs` and Blender `bpy` stubs):
  - **13 errors in 5 files** — all pre-existing type-annotation mismatches, none are runtime crashes:
    - `src/chemlab/simulation/reaction_solver.py:102` — tuple type mismatch
    - `src/chemlab/desktop/main_window.py:132,174,188` — PySide6 `Any` stubs, float/int assignment
    - `src/chemlab/media/google_media_bridge.py:318,538,551,662,690` — `Any` returns, str/list mismatch
    - `src/chemlab/ai/omniroute_bridge.py:131,171` — tuple type, `Any` return
    - `src/chemlab/ai/reagent_computer.py:141,151` — None/str assignment
- Blender-dependent files (`package/addon/*`, `safety_simulation/blender_bridge.py`, `scripts/*.py`, `tests/headless_blender_test.py`) fail only on missing `bpy` stubs — Blender is **not installed**; expected, not a defect.
- `mypy` was not previously installed in the venv; installed fresh during this session.

| `src/chemlab/` | Modern feature package | Packaged (the only tree included in the wheel) | IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED |
| `chemlab_core/` | Legacy isolated core | **OMITTED from wheel** — works only via `PYTHONPATH` | PARTIAL (packaging flaw) |
| `simulation/` (root) | Catalog, consequence, free sim | **OMITTED from wheel** | PARTIAL (packaging flaw) |
| `safety_simulation/` | Fume hood, GHS, thermal runaway | **OMITTED from wheel** | PARTIAL (packaging flaw) |
| `storage/` | Asset cache, cloud sync stubs | **OMITTED from wheel** | PARTIAL (packaging flaw) |

**Packaging flaw (confirmed):** only `src/chemlab` is distributed; `chemlab_core`, `simulation`, `safety_simulation`, and `storage` are importable locally only because `PYTHONPATH` includes the repo root. They will be missing from any installed wheel — matches `CURRENT_STATE_AUDIT.md` §3.4.
